statement: Let p ≥ 1, and let G be a smooth Riemannian metric jet of order p, with base G0 = g0, whose coefficients have finite angular type. Suppose that there are angular scalar jets C, E, with C0 = 2m0 and E0 = 0, such that (38.1) G − b = r−3 C dη2 + Er2 σ  + o(r−3 ). For the coefficient of degree j, 1 ≤ j ≤ p, suppose that the remainder satisfies this estimate after every mixed radial and angular derivative of total order at most p − j + 1. There is a smooth family of sphere jets Σs, 0 ≤ s < ∞, given by graphs over {s} × S2, with the following properties: (1) Σs has constant outward mean curvature through order p, and Σ0 is minimal through that order. (2) The graph coefficients have finite angular type. The normal lapse f for variation in s has base value f0 = 1. (3) If A(s) and H(s) are the area and mean curvature jets, then the CMC Hawking mass (38.2) mH(Σs) = s A(s) 16π 1 − (H(s)2 − 4)A(s) 16π ! SPACETIME PENROSE INEQUALITIES 237 satisfies, coefficientwise, (38.3) lim s→∞ mH(Σs) = mAH(G) := v u u tp0(G)2 − 3 X i=1 pi(G)2. Here pµ(G) is the coefficientwise flux (36.8), and the square root is its formal branch with base value m0 > 0.
